y-m-57-03.title: Yankin lambu idan tsawon shinge ya kayyade.
y-m-57-03.topic: Mafi girman ƙimar aikin quadratic da kewayon da aka yarda na abin canzawa.
y-m-57-03.goal: Yi amfani da tebur ka nemo inda mafi girman yankin da aka rubuta a matsayin quadratic yake faruwa; yanke da kanka cewa matsayin mafi girma na iya canzawa idan sabon sharadi ya canza kewayon abin canzawa, sannan nemo mafita cikin kewayon da kanka.
y-m-57-03.material: Kana son yin gonar kayan lambu mai siffar murabba’i ta amfani da bango a gefe guda. Ba a sa shinge a bangaren bangon ba, sauran gefuna ukun kuma a yi amfani da shingen 20 m duka. Idan gefuna biyun da suke tsaye wa bango tsawon x m ne, gefen da yake daidai da bango shi ne (20−2x) m. Don haka yankin lambun x(20−2x) m² ne, kuma 0<x<10.
y-m-57-03.thinking.0: Hasashen inda mafi girma yake da tebur.
y-m-57-03.thinking.1: Gyara hukunci ta la’akari da yadda sabon sharadi ke canza kewayon abin canzawa.
y-m-57-03.thinking.2: Nemo ƙimomi da ke cika sharudda biyu tare.
y-m-57-03.prereq.1: Saka ƙimomi cikin furuci mai harafi ka lissafa.
y-m-57-03.prereq.3: Karanta kewayon ƙimomin da suka cika rashin daidaito.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.prompt: A kowane mataki duba sabon bayani ka zaɓi hukuncinka kan x da ke ba da yanki mafi girma.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x=1,2,3,... ɗaya bayan ɗaya ka lissafa yanki. [lambobi: 1, 2, 3]
y-m-57-03.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta sabon sharadi a matsayin rashin daidaito a x, da farko yanke kewayon x masu yiwuwa.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Yayin da x ya ƙaru, gefuna biyu da suke tsaye da bango suna tsawo, amma gefen da yake daidai da bango (20−2x) yana gajarta. Har yanzu ba ka lissafa ƙima ba.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yaya yankin yake canzawa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa daga 0 zuwa 10?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan gefe guda ya tsawo, ɗayan yana gajarta, saboda haka ba za a yanke daga tasirin gefe ɗaya kaɗai ba. “b” zato ne, “d” kuma hukuncin da za a gwada da tebur. Mu gwada da tebur.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Da farko yana ƙaruwa, sannan daga wani wuri ya fara raguwa.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Da farko yana raguwa, daga baya kuma yana sake ƙaruwa.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za a iya faɗa ba sai an lissafa ƙimomi.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Daga tebur, me za ka yanke game da x da ke ba da yanki mafi girma?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Tebur yana da ƙimomi iri ɗaya hagu da dama na 5 (4 da 6 suna ba da 48, 3 da 7 suna ba da 42). Saboda haka 5 shi ne ɗan takara mafi girma. Idan aka sake rubuta furuci −2(x−5)²+50, za a iya tabbatar ko da x adadi goma ne cewa 50 a x=5 shi ne mafi girma.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ina yanke cewa mafi girma yana x=5 (cikin cikakkun lambobin tebur, 5 ma ya fi).
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ina yanke cewa mafi girma yana x=4.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ina yanke cewa mafi girma yana x=6.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Yana kusa da x=5, amma ya yi wuri a tabbatar kafin a gwada adadi goma.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Sabon bayani: bangon da za a sa lambun tsawonsa 8 m ne kawai. Gefen da ya yi daidai da bango (20−2x) ba zai wuce 8 m ba.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yanzu cikin x-ɗin da za su yiwu, yaya za ka yanke wanda ke ba da yanki mafi girma?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Daga 20−2x≤8, dole x≥6. Idan x=5, gefen daidai da bango 10 m ne, ya fi bango tsawo, ba zai yiwu ba. Ga x≥6, yayin ƙara x yankin yana raguwa, saboda haka 48 a x=6 shi ne mafi girma. Vertex na furuci (x=5) yana iya kasancewa wajen kewayon masu yiwuwa.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Sharadi ya canza, saboda haka ba za a iya yanke hukunci ba.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.reflect: Idan sabon sharadi ya fito, ba yana nufin hukuncinka na baya (x=5) kuskure ne ba; “kewayon x masu yiwuwa” ne ya canza, saboda haka matsayin mafi girma ma na iya canzawa. Faɗi wane bayani ya sauya hukuncinka, ko ko za ka iya riƙe shi yadda yake.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.prompt: Da sharadin bango 8 m, nemo ƙimomin x guda 3 dabam-dabam da yankin ya kai 46 m² ko fiye. (x na iya zama adadi goma.)
y-m-57-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo kewayon x bisa sharadin bangon, ka gwada ƙimomi cikin kewayon kawai.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo yankin a x=6, sannan ƙara x kaɗan-kaɗan ka duba sauyin yanki.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.ok.c1: x ya fi 0 amma ya gaza 10.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c1: x dole ya fi 0 kuma ya gaza 10.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Gefen da ya yi daidai da bango yana da 8 m ko ƙasa.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Gefen daidai da bango (20−2x) ya fi 8 m.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.explain: Daga sharadin bango x≥6; daga yankin x(20−2x)≥46, x kusan 6.41 ne ko ƙasa. Saboda haka amsa ita ce 6≤x≤6.41. Ga x=6.5 yankin 45.5 ne, bai isa ba.

y-m-57-01.title: Alaƙa huɗu: wanne ne aiki?
y-m-57-01.topic: Ma’anar aiki: alaƙar da ke ba kowane shigarwa sakamako guda ɗaya.
y-m-57-01.goal: Tantance alaƙa bisa mizani “sakamako guda ga kowane shigarwa”, nuna da misalan da ka ƙirƙira cewa shigarwa daban-daban na iya samun sakamako iri ɗaya amma har yanzu aiki ne, sannan ka bayyana yadda za a gyara alaƙar da ba aiki ba domin ta zama aiki.
y-m-57-01.material:
Idan akwai alaƙa (ƙa’ida), muna son duba sakamakon da ke fitowa ga shigarwa guda. Ga alaƙa huɗu: 
(가) haɗa kowane ɗalibi a aji da lambar halartarsa. (An riga an kayyade lambobin halarta.)
(나) haɗa lambar cikakkiya tabbatacciya x da masu rabanta tabbatattu.
(다) haɗa lambar cikakkiya x da murabba’inta.
(라) haɗa lambar gaske x mai 0 ko fiye da “lambar gaske y da murabba’inta ya yi daidai da x”.
y-m-57-01.thinking.0: Rubuta duk sakamakon kowane shigarwa bisa ƙa’idar alaƙar, sannan ka tantance.
y-m-57-01.thinking.1: Gina aiki inda shigarwa daban-daban ke samun sakamako iri ɗaya.
y-m-57-01.thinking.2: Gyara alaƙar da ba aiki ba ta sauya sharudda domin ta zama aiki.
y-m-57-01.prereq.0: H2 yana nuna matakin wahala da tallafi na wannan rukuni kawai; ba ajin makaranta ba ne. Ana ɗauka an riga an koyi abubuwan sakandare da ke ƙasa.
y-m-57-01.prereq.1: Ma’anar abu a saiti da kalmar alaƙa (matakin sakandare).
y-m-57-01.prereq.2: Saka ƙima a furuci domin nemo sakamako.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk alaƙar da ayyuka ne. (Aiki: alaƙa inda sakamako guda ɗaya tak ya tabbata ga kowane ƙimar shigarwa mai yiwuwa.)
y-m-57-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace alaƙa, zaɓi shigarwa guda ka rubuta duk sakamakon da ya fito.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowace alaƙa, zaɓi shigarwa biyu ko uku ka yi teburin “shigarwa → sakamako”, sannan ka duba layukan da shigarwa ko sakamakonsu iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya ƙidaya ɗaya bayan ɗaya yawan sakamako (lambobi) da kowane shigarwa (ɗalibi) yake da su.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.o.b: (나) lambar cikakkiya tabbatacciya x → masu rabanta tabbatattu
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.b: Ƙidaya yawan sakamako ga shigarwa 6. Mizani shi ne ko akwai ko da shigarwa ɗaya da ke da sakamako da yawa.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya bambance ko shigarwa daban-daban (misali 2 da −2) za su iya samun sakamako iri ɗaya da mizani na yawan sakamakon da kowane shigarwa ke samu.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.o.d: (라) lambar gaske x mai 0 ko fiye → y da murabba’inta x ne
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.d: Ga shigarwa 4, rubuta duk lambobin gaske y da murabba’insu 4 ne. Mizani shi ne ƙidaya yawansu.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.explain: Mizani na aiki shi ne “shin shigarwa guda yana ba da sakamako guda ɗaya kawai?” (가) aiki ne domin kowane ɗalibi yana da lamba guda; (다) ma aiki ne domin kowace lamba cikakkiya tana da murabba’i guda. Ba matsala ba ne 2 da −2 su ba da 4 a (다). (나) ba aiki ba ce domin 6 tana ba da 1, 2, 3, 6; (라) ma ba aiki ba ce domin 4 tana ba da 2 da −2.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.prompt: Yi la’akari da aiki f mai yankin {1, 2, 3} da kodomen {1, 2, 3, 4}. Samar da ayyuka 3 daban-daban da zangonsu ke da abubuwa 2 daidai. (p=f(1), q=f(2), r=f(3).)
y-m-57-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin nau’i-nau’i nawa daga cikin ƙimomi ukun f(1), f(2), f(3) dole su yi daidai domin a samu nau’in ƙima daban-daban guda biyu.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko zaɓi shigarwa biyun da za su sami ƙima iri ɗaya, sannan ka ba shigarwar da ta rage ƙima daban.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Ƙimomi ukun duka suna cikin kodomen {1, 2, 3, 4}.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c1: f(1), f(2), f(3) kowannensu dole ya zama ɗaya daga 1, 2, 3, 4.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Za ka iya amfani da abubuwan kodomen kawai. Adadi mai digo ba ya cikin kodomen.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Yawan ƙimomi daban-daban da suka fito daidai 2 ne.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Ba ƙimomi daban-daban 2 ba ne. Duba cewa ukun ba iri ɗaya duka ko daban-daban duka ba ne.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.explain: Zango mai abubuwa 2 yana nufin shigarwa biyu daga cikin ukun suna da sakamako iri ɗaya. Misali, f(1)=f(2)=1, f(3)=2 ma aiki ne. Akwai ayyuka 36 irin wannan gaba ɗaya. Aiki na iya ba shigarwa daban-daban sakamako iri ɗaya, amma shigarwa guda yana da sakamako guda ɗaya kawai.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.prompt: Ta yaya za ka gyara ƙa’idar alaƙa (라) domin ta zama aiki? Rubuta ƙa’idar da aka gyara da dalilin da ya sa gyaran ya yi aiki.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta duk y da suka cika sharadin idan x=4.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin sharadin da za ka iya ƙarawa domin a bar ƙima guda ɗaya kawai.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A ƙa’idar da ka kayyade, ka gwada da kanka cewa shigarwa kamar 4 yana ba da sakamako guda ɗaya kawai?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: “Dalilin” ya danganta da yawan ƙimomin da suka dace da 4?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunani ko wata hanya dabam da taka (misali y≤0 kawai) ma za ta yiwu?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.model.0: Na kayyade y≥0 kawai (tushen murabba’i). Da farko, idan x=4, y=2 da −2 ne, amma idan aka takaita zuwa 0 ko fiye, sakamako guda ɗaya ne kawai ya rage.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.model.1: Na yarda da ƙimomin y marasa ƙasa da 0 kawai domin kowane shigarwa ya ba da sakamako guda ɗaya. Matsalar ita ce 2 da −2 duk sun fito a x=4.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta bayyana takaita kewayo ta wata hanya dabam.

y-m-57-02.title: Binciken furucin “idan ya fi gangara, gangara ta fi girma”.
y-m-57-02.topic: Gangarar aikin layi: alama da kaifin gangara.
y-m-57-02.goal: Koyi cewa “mai gangara sosai” da “gangara mafi girma” ba koyaushe ɗaya ba ne; nemo ka gyara layin kuskure a kwatancin gangarori masu alamomi dabam-dabam, sannan ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa.
y-m-57-02.material: An zana jadawalin ayyukan layi y=2x da y=−3x a jirgin coordinate ɗaya. y=2x yana hawa zuwa dama, y=−3x kuma yana sauka zuwa dama. Gangara ita ce “canjin y idan x ya ƙaru da 1”. Ga rubutun ɗalibi da ya kwatanta gangarorin biyun.
y-m-57-02.thinking.0: Nemo kuskure ta raba layukan mafita zuwa gaskiya da faɗaɗa ƙa’ida.
y-m-57-02.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa da kanka inda faɗaɗa ƙa’idar ta gaza.
y-m-57-02.thinking.2: Faɗi sharuddan da faɗaɗa ƙa’idar ke aiki.
y-m-57-02.prereq.1: Ma’anar cewa a aikin layi y=ax+b, canjin y idan x ya ƙaru da 1 shi ne gangara a.
y-m-57-02.prereq.2: Kwatanta girman lambobi tabbatattu da marasa kyau a layin lambobi.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko a rubutun da ke ƙunshe da da’awa ba daidai ba. (Layukan da suka biyo daga da’awar ma na iya zama kuskure.)
y-m-57-02.s.s1.hint.0: Raba kowane layi zuwa “gaskiyar da aka karanta daga jadawali ko ma’auni” da “da’awar da aka samo daga ƙa’ida”.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sanya −3 da 2 a layin lambobi ka kwatanta wanne ya fi dama da kaifin gangarar jadawalin.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.0: Ga y=2x, idan x ya ƙaru da 1, y yana ƙaruwa da 2.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.1: Ga y=−3x, idan x ya ƙaru da 1, y yana raguwa da 3.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.2: Jadawali mafi gangara yana da gangara mafi girma.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.3: Jadawalin y=−3x ya fi gangara, saboda haka gangararsa ta fi girma. [lambobi: 3, 3]
y-m-57-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 da 2 gaskiyoyi ne da aka karanta daga jadawali. Layi na 3, “mai gangara yana da gangara mafi girma”, faɗaɗa ƙa’ida ce kuma ba ta aiki. Kaifin gangara yana kwatanta absolute value na gangara (3 da 2), girman gangara tare da alamarta kuma yana kwatanta −3 da 2. Layi na 4 sakamakon amfani da layi na 3 ne; a layi na 5, −3 yana hagu da 2 a layin lambobi, don haka −3<2.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri ayyukan layi y=ax+b guda 3 dabam-dabam da suka fi y=2x gangara amma gangararsu ta fi ƙanƙanta. y-intercept (b) dole ya zama 1.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sake rubuta “mai gangara” ta amfani da absolute value na gangara; nemo kewayon layin lambobi da ya cika wannan da “gangara ta fi ƙanƙanta”.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bayan zaɓar a mai yiwuwa, bincika sharuddan biyun dabam.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Ya fi y=2x gangara (absolute value na gangara ya fi 2).
y-m-57-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Gangarar jadawalin ba ta fi gangarar y=2x girma ba.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.explain: Domin ya fi gangara, absolute value na gangara ya fi 2, kuma gangarar ta gaza 2, saboda haka a<−2. Misalai: y=−3x+1, y=−5x+1, y=−2.5x+1. a=3 yana da gangara mafi girma ma, saboda haka ba misalin ƙaryatawa ba ne.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.prompt: Yanzu rubuta dabam yanayin da “jadawali ya fi gangara” da “gangara ta fi girma” suke nufin abu guda, da yanayin da ba haka ba.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta jerin kaifin gangara da jerin gangara idan duk gangarori tabbatattu ne, kamar 2 da 5.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta haka idan dukansu marasa kyau ne, kamar −2 da −5.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka gwada yanayin da suke nufin abu guda da gangarori takamaimai biyu?
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka danganta ɗayan yanayin da misalin ƙaryatawar da ka yi a baya?
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunani kuma kan gangara sifili? [lambobi: 0]
y-m-57-02.s.s3.model.0: Idan gangarorin biyu tabbatattu ne, mai gangara sosai ma yana da gangara mafi girma. Amma idan akwai mara kyau, kaifin gangara ana kwatanta shi da absolute value, saboda haka yana iya bambanta da kwatanta girman gangara.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.model.1: Idan jadawalinsu duka suna hawa zuwa dama, mai gangara sosai yana da gangara mafi girma. Idan ɗaya yana sauka, a kwatanta kaifin gangara ta absolute value, gangarori kuma ta alama.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta mai da hankali ga gefen lambobi marasa kyau.

y-m-57-04.title: Don sanin tsawon gangara.
y-m-57-04.topic: Rabo na trigonometry: kamanceceniya ta alwatika mai kusurwar dama da bayanin tsawo.
y-m-57-04.goal: Yanke wane bayani ya isa kayyade tsawon alwatika mai kusurwar dama zuwa ƙima guda, sannan tabbatar da misalan da ka gina cewa idan kusurwa ɗaya ce, rabon gefuna iri ɗaya ne ko da tsawonsu ya bambanta.
y-m-57-04.material: Kana son sa madaidaiciyar gangara daga ƙasa zuwa ƙofar gini. Ƙasan gangarar yana taɓa ƙasa, saman kuma yana taɓa farfajiyar ƙofa; ƙofar tana tsayin h m a tsaye daga ƙasa. (Ƙasa da farfajiyar ƙofa a kwance suke, gangara, tsawo a tsaye da tazara a ƙasa suna samar da alwatika mai kusurwar dama.) Ga tarin bayanan da mai zane ya rubuta. Kowane “kusurwa” shi ne “kusurwar gangara da ƙasa”; a wannan aiki muna amfani da sin 30°=1/2 (=tsawo÷hypotenuse).
y-m-57-04.thinking.1: Gane cewa kusurwa kaɗai ba ta kayyade girma.
y-m-57-04.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misalan alwatika mai kusurwar dama masu kamanceceniya da kanka.
y-m-57-04.prereq.1: Fahimtar matakin sakandare ƙaramar na dangantakar gefunan alwatika mai kusurwar dama.
y-m-57-04.prereq.2: Ma’anar cewa rabon gefuna da suka dace na siffofi masu kamanceceniya daidai suke.
y-m-57-04.prereq.3: Bayanin cewa sine na 30° shi ne 1/2 (an bayar a wannan aiki).
y-m-57-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk tarin da bayaninsu kaɗai ke kayyade tsawon h na ƙofar zuwa ƙima guda.
y-m-57-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane tarin, ƙirga ka rubuta adadin “ƙimomin da aka sani” da “ƙimomin da ba a sani ba”.
y-m-57-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka zana a tunani alwatika biyu masu kusurwa ɗaya amma girma dabam, ka bincika ko tarin ya bambanta su.
y-m-57-04.s.s1.o.a: Tsawon gangara 10 m, tazara a ƙasa daga ƙarshen gangara zuwa gini 6 m.

y-m-57-04.s.s1.r.d: Hukunci ne da ya tambayi ko kusurwa guda da gefe guda suna kayyade sauran gefuna ta rabon kamanceceniya.

y-m-57-05.title: Wuraren da suke da tazara ɗaya daga tashoshin tushe biyu.
y-m-57-05.topic: Jirgin coordinate: maki masu daidaitacciyar tazara daga maki biyu.
y-m-57-05.goal: Gane cewa midpoint ba shi ne maki guda kaɗai da tazararsa ɗaya daga maki biyu ba; gina maki da dama makamantan haka, sannan bayyana siffar da suke jera a kai.
y-m-57-05.material: A jirgin coordinate (raka’ar grid 1 km ce), tashoshin tushe A(1,2) da B(7,10) suna nan. Ana son sanya antenna na wucin gadi a P(x,y). Tazara tsakanin (x₁,y₁) da (x₂,y₂) ita ce “tushen murabba’i tabbatacce na (x₁−x₂)²+(y₁−y₂)²”. Midpoint na maki biyu shi ne maki mai x-coordinate da y-coordinate matsakaitan coordinates ɗin biyun. Midpoint na tashoshin A da B shi ne M(4,6). [lambobi: 1, 1, 2, 7, 10, 4, 6]
y-m-57-05.thinking.0: Bincika ko amsa ɗaya da aka saba (midpoint) ta isa.
y-m-57-05.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri maki da dama da suka cika sharadin.
y-m-57-05.prereq.1: Rubuta matsayin maki a jirgin coordinate da (x,y).
y-m-57-05.prereq.2: Ma’anar tazara tsakanin maki biyu da midpoint (an bayyana a cikin wannan aiki).
y-m-57-05.prereq.3: Lissafi da lambobi marasa cikakkiya (adadi mai digo).
y-m-57-05.s.s1.prompt: Maki P nawa ne suke da tazara iri ɗaya daga A da B?
y-m-57-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ban da tsakiyar M, zaɓi wasu koორდinati, sannan ka lissafta ka kwatanta murabba’in tazarorin maki zuwa A da B.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta furuci biyu na murabba’in tazara da x da y, sannan ka daidaita su.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.r.a: Hukunci ne da ya nemo waɗanda za su iya zama maki ban da tsakiya, sannan ya gwada su.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.r.b: Gaskiya ne cewa tsakiya tana da wannan sifa. Amma dole a bincika ko ita kaɗai ce. Kwatanta tazarorin maki da aka matsar gefe kaɗan daga tsakiyar.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya sani daga koòrdinati kaɗai ba.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.r.c: An bayar da koòrdinatin A da B, saboda haka za a iya lissafta a kwatanta tazarori. Za ka iya gwada kai tsaye ko maki ya cika sharadin.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.r.d: Idan ka yi tunanin wuraren haɗuwar da’irori biyu masu radius tabbatacce, wannan yanayin ne inda tazarar aka kayyade. A nan tazarori biyu kawai dole su yi daidai da juna, ba a kayyade ƙimarsu ba.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.explain: Tsakiyar M(4, 6) tana cika PA=PB, amma akwai wasu maki ma. Misali, (8, 3) yana da murabba’in tazara daga A 7²+1²=50, daga B kuma 1²+7²=50; sun yi daidai. Akwai maki marasa iyaka a kan layi irin wannan.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.prompt: Nemo maki P(x, y) guda 3 daban-daban da suka cika PA=PB. Kada a haɗa tsakiyar M, kuma P ya kasance a zangon farko (x>0, y>0). (Adadi mai digo ma ya dace.)
y-m-57-05.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi x, sannan ka warware y ɗin da ake bukata domin murabba’in tazarori biyun su yi daidai.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sanya maki da ka samo gefe da gefe, sannan ka kwatanta y nawa ke sauyawa idan x ya sauya.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.fail.c1: x da y duka dole su fi 0 girma.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Tazarar zuwa A da ta zuwa B sun yi daidai.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Tazarar zuwa A da ta zuwa B ba su yi daidai ba.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ka riga ka san tsakiyar M. Nemo wani maki.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.explain: Idan PA=PB ne, ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu murabba’i yana ba da 3x+4y=36. Duk maki a wannan layin da suke zangon farko amsoshi ne. Misalai: (8, 3), (2, 7.5), (6, 4.5). Layin yana wucewa ta M(4, 6), kuma yana tsaye da AB.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta irin siffar da kake tsammanin maki da ka samo za su yi idan aka zana su a faifan koòrdinati, tare da dalilinka.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Zana maki ukun da ka samo kusan a faifan koòrdinati, sannan ka yi tunanin sifar da suke jera a kanta.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Kwatanta ko tsakiyar M tana kan layi ɗaya da waɗannan maki.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka zaɓi maki biyu daga cikin waɗanda ka samo ka duba ko gangarorinsu iri ɗaya ne?
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka duba ko tsakiya tana kan layi ɗaya?
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin yiwuwar sifar da’ira ma?
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Ina ganin duk suna kan layi guda. Layin yana wucewa ta tsakiya kuma yana tsaye da AB; za a iya ganin cewa idan x ya ƙaru, y yana raguwa da ƙima tabbatacciya a kowane lokaci.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Maki suna jere a layi madaidaiciya. Kamar (8, 3), (6, 4.5), (2, 7.5), idan x ya ragu da 2, y yana ƙaruwa da 1.5, kuma layin yana wucewa ta tsakiya.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Amsa misali da aka rubuta ta ƙa’idar koòrdinati na maki da aka samo.

y-m-57-06.title: Menene “na wakilci” ga yawan baƙi?
y-m-57-06.topic: Ƙimomin wakilci na bayanai: yadda ake amfani da matsakaici da median.
y-m-57-06.goal: Duba yadda matsakaici da median ke sauyawa idan aka haɗa ƙima guda babba sosai a bayanai, sannan ka yanke cewa zaɓin ƙimar da za a yi amfani da ita ya danganta da abin da ake son yi (manufa), kuma ka bayyana da misalinka.
y-m-57-06.material: Laburaren gari yana rubuta yawan baƙi (mutane) kowace rana. Ana amfani da yawan baƙin domin kayyade adadin ma’aikatan aiki da kayan bayanin da za a shirya. An bayar da bayanan kwanaki 6 na farko a matakan ƙasa, sannan a ƙara bayanin rana ta 7.
y-m-57-06.thinking.0: Duba hukuncinka bayan an ƙara bayanai.
y-m-57-06.thinking.1: Nemo mizani (manufa) na zaɓen ƙimar wakilci.
y-m-57-06.thinking.2: Ka ƙirƙiri yanayi da kanka inda matsakaici ya dace da inda median ya dace.
y-m-57-06.prereq.1: Ma’anar matsakaici (jimillar bayanai ÷ yawan bayanai) da median (ƙimar tsakiya idan an jera bisa girma).
y-m-57-06.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, jera bayanai bisa girma sannan ka lissafta ƙimar tsakiya da matsakaici da kanka.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.hint.1: Raba “son sanin ranar da aka saba” da “son sanin jimilla”, sannan ka kwatanta su.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Yawan baƙi (mutane) a kwanaki 6 na farko: 40, 42, 45, 41, 43, 44. (Matsakaici 42.5 ne; idan an jera bisa girma, median—matsakaicin ƙimomin tsakiya 42 da 43—ma 42.5 ne.)
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan za ka bayyana yawan baƙin da ake samu a “ranar da aka saba” a wannan laburare da ƙima guda, wace ce ta dace?
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Ƙimomin sun taru tsakanin 40 da 45, saboda haka kusan mutane 42.5 ya isa. Yanzu an ƙara bayanin rana ta 7.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Matsakaici da median iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka wannan bayanan ne da hukunci iri ɗaya zai fito ko wanne aka yi amfani da shi.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Mutane 45 (bisa ranar da ta fi yawan baƙi).
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Mafi girman ƙima ita ce ranar da ta fi yawan baƙi, ba ranar da aka saba ba.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Bayanan ƙimomi 6 ne kawai, saboda haka ba za a iya faɗin wata ƙima ba.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ko da bayanai kaɗan ne, idan ƙimomi sun taru za ka iya yin ƙiyasin. Cewa ba a tabbatar ba ya bambanta da cewa ba za a iya cewa komai ba.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Mutane 40 (bisa ranar da ta fi ƙarancin baƙi).
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Mafi ƙarancin ƙima ita ce ranar da ta fi shiru. Ba ta wakiltar ranar da aka saba ba.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.info: A rana ta 7 an yi bikin gari, baƙi 300 suka zo. Yanzu bayanan kwanaki 7 su ne 40, 42, 45, 41, 43, 44, 300. Matsakaici kusan mutane 79.3 ne, median kuma (ƙima ta 4 daga mafi ƙanƙanta) mutane 43 ne.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan za ka bayyana “ranar da aka saba” a cikin kwanaki 7, yaya za ka yanke hukunci?
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Babu ko rana guda daga cikin 7 da ke da matsakaicin mutane 79.3 (ranakun da suka fi kusa suna da 45 ko 300). Idan ana bayyana “ranar da aka saba”, median na mutane 43 ya fi daidaito. Amma ya danganta idan manufar ta bambanta.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ranar biki guda ta ja matsakaici sama sosai. Duba ko akwai rana a bayanai da ta yi kusa da mutane 79 da gaske.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hukunci ne da ya yi ƙoƙarin bayyana “ranar da aka saba” da ƙimar da matsananciyar ƙima ɗaya ba ta shafa sosai ba.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ya danganta da abin da ake son yi.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya ce ƙimar wakilci na iya bambanta bisa manufar amfani da ita.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: An gauraya baƙi 300, saboda haka ba za a iya amfani da waɗannan bayanai ba.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kasancewar akwai ƙima mai tsanani ba ya nufin a watsar da duk bayanai. Duba wace ƙima ba ta shafar bayanai sosai.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Sabon bayani: laburaren na sa ran mako mai zuwa ma zai ƙunshi kwanaki 7, ciki har da ranar biki guda kamar wannan makon, kuma zai shirya takardun bayani 2 ga kowane baƙo. Kana son ƙiyasta jimillar takardun da ake bukata a kwanaki 7 na mako mai zuwa.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wane lissafi ne ya fi dacewa wajen ƙiyasta jimillar takardu?
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Matsakaici × yawan kwanaki = jimilla (79.3×7=555 mutane). Idan manufar ita ce jimillar adadi, matsakaici ya dace. Median na iya dacewa wajen bayyana ranar da aka saba; matsakaici kuma wajen shirin jimillar adadi. Ko da ka bar hukuncinka na mataki na 2 (median) yadda yake, har yanzu hukunci ne daidai ga manufar “ranar da aka saba”.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Matsakaicin kwanaki 6 na farko, mutane 42.5 × kwanaki 7 × takardu 2 = takardu 595.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: An lissafta da bayanan da suka cire ranar biki. Mako mai zuwa zai ƙunshi ranar biki.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: An lissafta bisa ranar da aka saba. Domin jimilla, ana kuma bukatar baƙi da yawa na ranar biki.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Matsakaici kusan mutane 79.3 × kwanaki 7 × takardu 2 ≈ takardu 1110.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya yi amfani da cewa matsakaici × yawan kwanaki jimillar duk kwanaki 7 ne.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Mafi girman ƙima, mutane 300 × kwanaki 7 × takardu 2 = takardu 4200.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan ya ɗauka cewa kowace rana ranar biki ce. Za a shirya fiye da kima sosai.
y-m-57-06.s.s1.reflect: Da bayanai iri ɗaya, ƙimar da ta dace ta sauya lokacin da manufar ta sauya. Idan hukuncinka ya sauya a mataki na 3, faɗi abin da ya sauya shi; idan bai sauya ba, faɗi manufar da ka ɗauka.
y-m-57-06.s.s2.prompt: Bayar da manufa guda inda matsakaici ya fi dacewa da wata inda median ya fi dacewa, sannan ka rubuta misalai ban da laburare.
y-m-57-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin abin da matsakaici × yawan ƙimomi ke wakilta.
y-m-57-06.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ƙimar bayanai guda ta yi girma ba kamar sauran ba, ka kwatanta da ƙimomin matakan baya wanne daga matsakaici da median ya fi motsawa.
y-m-57-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa matsakaici ya dace a misalinka (misali, domin ana bukatar jimilla)?
y-m-57-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: A misalinka inda median ya dace, ka faɗi takamaiman irin ƙima mai tsanani da ke ciki?
y-m-57-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka ƙirƙiri sabon misali da ba na laburare ba?
y-m-57-06.s.s2.model.0: Lokacin tsara jimillar kuɗi, matsakaici ya dace domin matsakaici × yawan kwanaki shi ne jimilla. Idan ana bayyana ranar da aka saba, median ya fi dacewa idan rana ɗaya ko biyu sun yi girma sosai.
y-m-57-06.s.s2.model.1: Idan ana kayyade jimillar buhunan shara na wata, ina amfani da matsakaici; idan ana bayyana farashin gidan da aka saba a unguwa inda akwai gidaje kaɗan masu tsada sosai, median ya fi kyau.
y-m-57-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa misali da aka rubuta da wani batu daban.

y-m-57-09.goal: Koyi cewa ko da matsakaicin gudu (tazara÷lokaci) ɗaya ne, wurare a tsakiyar tafiya na iya bambanta; faɗi ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata don sanin wurin tsakiya, sannan ƙirƙiri gudu-gudu biyu masu cika sharadi.
y-m-57-09.material: A madaidaiciyar hanya a wurin shakatawa, Jiyun da Hajun sun fara wuri guda lokaci guda, suka yi tafiya alkibla ɗaya na minti 20. Jiyun ta yi gudu daidai, bayan minti 20 ta isa maki 2000m daga farawa. Hajun ma ya isa 2000m bayan minti 20. Ba mu san yadda Hajun ya yi tafiya a tsakanin ba. Hajun bai juya baya ba (motsi gaba ko tsayawa kawai). Raka’ar gudu m/min ce.

y-m-57-09.s.s1.r.b: Idan ka yanke iri ɗaya saboda babu dalili, zato ne marar tushe. Za su iya zama iri ɗaya ko dabam.

y-m-57-10.title: Jadawalin f(x−2) yana wane gefe?
y-m-57-10.topic: Jadawalin aiki: sauya wuri da sauye-sauye a furuci.
y-m-57-10.goal: Ba tare da dogara da siffar “−2” a furuci ba, yi amfani da hanyar duba wurin jadawali ta ƙimomin aiki, sannan ƙirƙiri furucin parabola da aka sauya wuri da ya cika sharadi.
y-m-57-10.material: Kana son motsa jadawalin f(x)=x² bisa ƙa’ida don samun g(x)=f(x−2). (A x-axis, dama ita ce alkiblar tabbatacciya.) Ɗalibi ya bayyana jadawalin g kamar haka.
y-m-57-10.thinking.0: Tabbatar da ƙa’ida da aka samo daga siffar furuci ta saka ƙimomi.
y-m-57-10.thinking.1: Nemo layi mai kuskure ka bayar da dalili.
y-m-57-10.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri furuci da ke cika sharadi, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ƙima guda ke kayyade wata.
y-m-57-10.prereq.1: Saka ƙima cikin furucin aiki don nemo ƙimar aikin.
y-m-57-10.prereq.2: Siffar jadawalin y=x² da gaskiyar vertex ɗinsa (0,0). [lambobi: 0, 0]
y-m-57-10.prereq.3: Saka ƙimomi cikin haruffa ka sauƙaƙa furuci.
y-m-57-10.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x=2 da x=−2 cikin g, ka lissafa ƙimomin g.
y-m-57-10.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta inda x yake sa g ya fi ƙanƙanta da vertex (0,0) na f. [lambobi: 0, 0]
y-m-57-10.s.s1.line.0: Vertex na jadawalin f(x)=x² shi ne (0,0). [lambobi: 0, 0]
y-m-57-10.s.s1.line.2: Akwai −2 a furuci, saboda haka an matsar da jadawali −2 a alkiblar x, wato 2 zuwa hagu.
y-m-57-10.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka vertex na g shi ne (−2,0). [lambobi: 2, 0]
